System

Quest DAG, objectives, journal and once-only rewards

Quests track server-approved actions through a versioned dependency graph. The journal is an observer. Gathering, combat, loot, delivery, talk, interaction, exploration, crafting, fishing and dungeon/boss objectives each consume explicit verified events.

Scope and player interaction

Quests track server-approved actions through a versioned dependency graph. The journal is an observer. Gathering, combat, loot, delivery, talk, interaction, exploration, crafting, fishing and dungeon/boss objectives each consume explicit verified events.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase15committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

Unavailable → Available → Active → ObjectivesComplete → RewardPending → Completed → Abandoned

WBP_QuestJournal observes results from URPGQuestComponent. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_Quest_RoadSupplies. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
QuestId/version and prerequisite quest DAG: no cycles
ObjectiveId/type/target/count: stable IDs; types Kill,Gather,Loot,Deliver,Talk,Interact,Explore,Craft,Fish,DungeonBoss
QuestState and objective counters: durable, monotonic under objective policy
EventId: unique verified gameplay fact; objective-event deduplication
RewardEntitlementId: unique character/quest/completion-cycle key
RepeatPolicy: None initially; explicit server cycle ID for future repeatables/dailies
PartySharePolicy: per objective, not blanket nearby-player credit

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGQuestComponentImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_QuestJournalLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
AcceptQuest(CommandId, QuestId, NPCContext) -> Accepted|Unavailable|AlreadyActive
ApplyVerifiedQuestEvent(EventId, CharacterId, EventPayload) -> Progressed|Duplicate|NotRelevant
AbandonQuest(CommandId, QuestId) -> Abandoned|CannotAbandon; declared item cleanup
ClaimQuestReward(CommandId, QuestId, RewardChoiceId, NPCContext) -> Completed|NotReady|NoSpace|AlreadyClaimed

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. NPC_Mara offers RoadSupplies only when prerequisites/level/flags permit; Accept persists active state and zeroed objective identities.
  2. Player kills a Mossfang, loots cloth, mines CopperOre, chops AshLog, catches RiverDace and crafts IronHatchet. Each domain emits a verified, deduplicated gameplay fact after its authoritative commit.
  3. Quest component/backend applies matching objective progress once using EventId; an item purchase cannot masquerade as a Gather event unless the objective intentionally asks for possession.
  4. Delivery checks current owned items at turn-in and consumes them atomically; prior gather progress is not proof the materials are still owned.
  5. When objectives are complete, dialogue/journal show ready state. Claim validates NPC/range, current objective state, reward choice and inventory capacity.
  6. One transaction consumes delivery items, records completion/consequences, grants XP/currency/item, unlocks the next quest and stores reward receipt. Cross-zone retry returns the existing result.
  7. Abandonment follows authored cleanup without rerolling/regranting rewards on reacceptance. Repeatables require explicit cycle IDs and are not enabled by default.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Create DA_Quest_RoadSupplies and a small chain: FirstSteps -> RoadSupplies -> TheSluiceSignal. Validate prerequisite DAG, stable objective IDs and reward references.
  2. Build WBP_QuestJournal and WBP_ObjectiveTracker with available/active/ready/completed states, pin/unpin and map marker links. Do not use widget booleans as quest state.
  3. Add URPGQuestComponent to PlayerState and subscribe to verified fact receipts emitted by prior combat/gather/fish/craft/loot/explore systems. Backfill is opt-in per objective, not accidental replay of all historical events.
  4. Reopen DA_Dialogue_Mara to branch on authoritative quest state and offer turn-in. Add quest-giver/ready markers to NPC presentation using safe public or owner-only state.
  5. Seed exact objective counts in the worked chain and add a full-bag turn-in fixture. Include separate objective samples for talk/interact/explore/deliver/dungeon so every supported type has a test row.

Reopen Phase15 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_Rillmere / NPC_Mara / Quest_RoadSupplies / Station_Forge. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Replay gather/kill EventId -> unchanged objective count.
Purchase ore for a Gather objective -> no progress; possession/delivery objectives behave separately.
Full bag at final reward -> NoSpace, delivery items not consumed, quest remains ready.
Claim after zone transfer with old nonce -> refreshed NPC context required; completed entitlement cannot grant twice.
Quest DAG cycle or missing target -> content validation failure.
Abandon/reaccept after completed reward -> no new entitlement for a nonrepeatable quest.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

RoadSupplies fixture requires 1 kill, 1 loot, 2 ore, 3 logs, 1 fish and 1 craft; rewards proposed 100 XP and 200 currency. Escort quests are gated until navigation/recovery/party proof; daily resets are not approved/enabled.

Track QuestId/ObjectiveId/EventId and reward receipt, not client tracker animations. Objective text has pluralization/localization support and clear source verbs; map markers do not expose undiscovered secrets unintentionally.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
